craft_notes: Sthāyin: guard and union — hands, drops, secrecy. Rows: substitute, pleasures, guard, union. Rejected: literal shell — killed: adjudicated hand-pose. Read aloud: low, secret tread.

lines: On the ground set the world-bowl; sate the ring; sate yourself with the hailed.
No bowl? Folded shell-hands, blest; or the right hand bowled — blest —
two together, right above, seamless — folded shell-hands; falling drops delight the haunters, the stream delights the Dread.
None may enter here; the strayed-in doubt not; instead redouble the wheel-rite.
Fritters and dishes scatter freely before them, as they please —
in the hidden house, nameless, all gathered under god: so the heroes' mingling-rite.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra ādhāre viśvamayaṃ pātraṃ sthāpayitvā devatācakraṃ tarpayitvā svātmānaṃ vanditena tena tarpayet pātrābhāve bhadraṃ vellitaśuktiḥ vā dakṣahastena pātrākāraṃ bhadraṃ dvābhyām uparigatadakṣiṇābhyāṃ niḥsaṃdhīkṛtābhyām vellitaśuktiḥ patadbhiḥ bindubhiḥ vetālaguhyakāḥ saṃtuṣyanti dhārayā bhairavaḥ atra praveśo na kasyacit deyaḥ pramādāt praviṣṭasya vicāraṃ na kuryāt kṛtvā punar dviguṇaṃ cakrayāgaṃ kuryāt tato 'vadaṃśān bhojanādīn ca agre yatheṣṭaṃ vikīryeta guptagṛhe vā saṃketābhidhānavarjaṃ devatāśabdena sarvān yojayet iti vīrasaṃkarayāgaḥ
